entries.description: The model download call goes through the generic JSON proxy and parses the reply with JSON.parse, but the download endpoint answers with a server-sent-event stream, so every model download from the UI fails with a JSON syntax error.
The voice-conversion request sent to the sidecar omits the original video duration, so the sidecar skips padding and the converted audio comes out shorter than the video and cuts off early.

The path check that is meant to confine file reads to allowed directories compares string prefixes, so a sibling directory that shares a prefix with an allowed one (for example 'data-evil' next to 'data') passes.

The cached voice prompt is loaded in torch's restricted tensors-only mode, which rejects the prompt's class (a list of qwen-tts VoiceClonePromptItem objects saved by the same module), so every load raises, the error is swallowed and the cache is never used.
The delete-profile route does not handle the ValueError that the profile code now raises for an invalid id, so a bad id returns a 500 instead of a 400 or 404.

The hallucination filter drops any transcription segment whose compression ratio is high, and the Whisper call keeps its own repetition suppression on, so valid repeated phrases are thrown away or collapsed and the generated voice-over loses speech.
A 30 second health-check timeout is also used by the UI-facing connection probes, so a status check can hang for 30 seconds when the sidecar is unreachable.
Silence insertion between words assumes every word has a real duration; words Whisper gives zero duration collapse onto one timestamp, producing zero gaps and wrongly proportioned padding.

If reading the keychain fails for any reason other than 'no entry', the code treats it as an empty vault and returns the config with blank secrets; the frontend then holds blank secrets and its next save writes them back, overwriting every stored secret with blanks.

The migration of old plaintext secrets into the keychain only triggers when the ElevenLabs key or the access token is set, so a config holding only the Drive client secret or refresh token is never migrated and keeps those secrets in config.json.

After moving secrets to the keychain the code rewrites config.json to strip them but ignores a failed write, and it has no completion marker, so the plaintext secrets can stay on disk and the migration reruns on every config load.

The compositor log line always reports the screen size and a webcam overlay, which is wrong when the canvas is a cropped region without a webcam.

The new delete-model command builds the sidecar URL by pasting the frontend-supplied model name into the path with no validation, so a name containing path segments reaches other sidecar routes with the DELETE method (for example a voice profile), outside the model routes the command is meant for.
The YouTube download passes no playlist or retry limits to yt-dlp, so a playlist or channel URL makes it work through every entry with no download cap and no socket timeout.

Transcription loads a different Hugging Face repository than the one the model download endpoint fetches and the status check reports: the download map points Whisper at the mlx-community repository while the transcribe function loads the openai one, so the model the setup step downloads is never the one transcription uses, and the first transcription has to fetch another model on its own.
Cached voice prompts are loaded onto the CPU while the model runs on the Apple GPU device, so a cached prompt is not on the same device as a freshly created one.

The generic sidecar proxy gives every request 30 seconds, and the create-voice page sends transcription through it, so a transcription that has to load the Whisper model first can exceed the limit and be reported as failed.

The change adds a voice-conversion mode that needs a third model (CosyVoice3) but leaves it out of the model status list and the download map, so the setup wizard never shows it or downloads it and the first conversion has to fetch the model on its own in the middle of the job.
After a Drive upload the card writes the new link straight into the recording object it received as a prop instead of updating the shared library state.
